issues: Verdict and all three confirmed citations hold up. Refinements: (1) Name clash at appendix line 55. The paper calls det(I+AB)=det(I+BA) 'Sylvester's identity', but it is Sylvester's DETERMINANT THEOREM (Weinstein-Aronszajn). 'Sylvester's determinant identity' usually means the bordered-minor identity (Wikipedia, fetched). From memory, Horn-Johnson Ch.0's 'Sylvester's identity' is the bordered one too, so the checker's pointer [Ch. 0--1] could send readers to the wrong statement. Reword and cite HJ Ch.1 (AB and BA share their non-zero eigenvalues). (2) I could not verify the Horn-Johnson theorem numbers (Hadamard = Thm 7.8.1 is from memory; web search was unavailable). Crossref confirms Ch.7 'Positive Definite and Semidefinite Matrices' pp.425-516 and Ch.1 pp.43-82, so cite by chapter. (3) DLMF: 5.12 alone does not give pi/sin; you need 5.12.3 (b=1-a), 5.12.1 and 5.5.3, all fetched. Replace the checker's @misc with the official NIST:DLMF entry (Release 1.2.8 of 2026-09-15, editors Olver et al.), with the equation numbers in the \citep optional argument. (4) SSV: 2nd ed., De Gruyter Studies in Mathematics 37, confirmed (Open Library + Crossref 'Preface to the second edition'). Crossref chapter records confirm 'Chapter 8. Thorin-Bernstein functions', so cite Ch.8 for the other-penalties remark. Math of lem:bernstein and lem:minor re-derived: correct.
